results.query: What does the AI Product Photoshoot & Ads course teach?
results.answer: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

results.query: Give me the Lesson 02 workflow for making a product sheet from phone photos.
results.answer:
Lesson 02

Take 5–7 clear phone photos from different angles in daylight, with flash off. In Google Flow choose New project → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

results.query: Teach me the Lesson 05 ad planning workflow in steps.
results.answer:
Lesson 05

Provide real product details, price and where you sell. First ask for three buyer types, their problems and an ad angle for each. Choose one angle, then request 5 hooks, a 15-second script and an Instagram caption. Use only supplied features; add no unsupported claims. Next request 3 Google Flow image prompts and run them with the product sheet. Review and remove false or unproven claims.
